Hi Maya,

Thanks for sending the draft Order Form. Procurement reviewed the file and we have a few open items that will determine whether we can sign the pilot SOW this week:

- Pricing buckets: the draft references a per-token banding that looks like it assumes full-commit usage. We need the explicit per-band ramp schedule (months 1-3, baseline vs burst) so our FP&A can model cashflow.
- Minimum commit: the draft includes a 6-month minimum. Can you confirm whether min-commit charges are invoiceable up front, or can they be pro-rated across tranches?
- Net terms / invoicing entity: our standard is Net 30 to the contracting entity on the PO. Which Redwood legal entity should appear on the PO and invoice?
- Taxes: Novamed is EU-headquartered; please confirm Redwood's VAT treatment and whether you can provide a W-9 / VAT certificate for cross-border treatment.

I've attached the current OrderForm_v3 that our legal team annotated (see attachment). We'd like a single updated order form with tracked changes plus a short note confirming: invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly), whether min-commit is billed upfront or tranches, and the invoicing entity name and address.

If we can close these four bullets we should be able to proceed to PO issuance by EOD Friday.

Best,

Hi all — quick finance/legal checklist and our requirements so you can pass to your accounting/legal: 

1) Invoicing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — billing address and tax information will be provided on the invoice. We can also route invoices to Redwood Europe Limited if the purchase must be booked in EU, but that requires legal approval and may affect VAT. Please confirm which entity Novamed will remit to.

2) Taxes / VAT: If Novamed is EU-based, please provide your VAT ID and a billing contact. For reverse-charge treatment we need a valid VAT registration and a signed EU self-billing agreement in some jurisdictions.

3) PO and PO header: please include PO number on the invoice header and in the invoice body line items. If your PO has a specific remit-to or distribution account, include that now so we can align bank wiring.

4) Minimum commit invoicing options we can accept: 
   - Option A (preferred): 50% upfront at signature, 25% at month 3, 25% at month 6.
   - Option B: pro-rate the min-commit monthly across months 1–6 and invoice monthly (requires that the PO cover the total committed value up front or via a standing PO).
   - Option C: full upfront invoice (we accept if Novamed can provide immediate payment).

5) Evidence: send VAT ID or W-9 equivalent; if VAT reverse-charge is needed, include the legal justification. 

I've attached a short tax evidence checklist that shows the docs we need and the timelines (tax_evidence_checklist.xlsx). Once we have the VAT ID and preferred invoicing entity, I will confirm the invoice remit name and pre-fill the invoice footer language.

Kim
